# Lexicon

> A personal lexicon for voice-to-agents: one YAML file of the names and jargon
> speech-to-text keeps getting wrong, applied to every transcript before an
> agent reads it. MIT-licensed, local, no account.

This repository is the source; the maintained, generated copies of the
machine-readable docs are served from the site and are the versions to quote:

- <https://lexicon.ashlr.ai/llms.txt>: short index of the site.
- <https://lexicon.ashlr.ai/llms-full.txt>: install, tools, exports, benchmarks,
  privacy and FAQ in one fetch.
- <https://lexicon.ashlr.ai/mcp.json>: install manifest; merge `.mcpServers`
  verbatim.
- <https://lexicon.ashlr.ai/capabilities.json>: capabilities, install commands
  and verification as JSON.
- <https://lexicon.ashlr.ai/AGENTS.md>: docs/AGENTS.md served from the domain.

## In this repository

- [docs/AGENTS.md](docs/AGENTS.md): written to the agent doing the install.
- [docs/QUICKSTART.md](docs/QUICKSTART.md): nothing to working in five minutes.
- [docs/MCP.md](docs/MCP.md): the tools, resources and prompts.
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): the full documentation index.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how to work on this codebase.
- [server.json](server.json): the MCP registry manifest.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): the trust model.
